output.name: CAD client crashes/freezes on large drawings and shaded view
output.summary: Engineers' CAD client freezes or crashes when opening large parts, assemblies or drawings, or when switching to shaded view, until support enables large assembly mode and updates the graphics driver.

root_cause.text: Likely the standard CAD workstation configuration ships with large assembly mode disabled and an outdated graphics driver, so large models and shaded rendering overwhelm the client until each machine is fixed by hand.

quotes.quote: Enabled large assembly mode and updated the graphics driver.
Crash when switching to shaded view.

evidence.text: Every listed ticket was resolved with the identical per-machine fix, indicating a known configuration gap rather than varied defects.

quotes.quote: Enabled large assembly mode and updated the graphics driver.
Enabled large assembly mode and updated the graphics driver.

evidence.text: Crashes are repeatable on specific files across part, assembly and drawing types, pointing to model size rather than file corruption.

quotes.quote: CAD client crashes every time I open busbar_600.prt.
CAD client crashes every time I open cover_828.asm.
CAD client crashes every time I open panel_891.drw.

evidence.text: Shaded-view crashes recur frequently, consistent with a graphics driver issue.

quotes.quote: Crash when switching to shaded view.
Crash when switching to shaded view.

output.fix: Bake large assembly mode into the default CAD client configuration and add the certified graphics driver to the managed workstation image with automated driver compliance enforcement, so no user machine runs CAD without them.
